description: Server-side extension that completes the full analysis pipeline for NLP text classification after vera-ai-nlp-reviewing has run. Adds SVM, Random Forest, LightGBM classifiers with TF-IDF and optional extra features, subgroup analysis by metadata or text properties, deep learning models (GRU, TextCNN, ALBERT with optional tabular fusion and hyperparameter search), cross-method comparison with unified feature importance on a 0-100 scale, and manuscript-ready methods.md and results.md. Applies output variation and code style diversity for natural, non-repetitive output. Open-source skill. Triggered after vera-ai-nlp-reviewing completes and its PART 0–2 artifacts are present (see ../../CROSS-SKILL-INTERFACE.md). If invoked directly without those artifacts, halts and prompts the user to run testing first or supply equivalent PART 0–2 code.
